content_sections.text: PhD will be considered as 4 years’ experience (irrespective of the duration taken to complete the degree, provided the period spent on obtaining minimum essential educational qualification shall not count towards experience). MD/MS or equivalent to be considered as 3 years’ experience (provided the period spent on obtaining minimum essential educational qualification shall not count towards experience). MPH/M. Tech will not be considered as any experience. Experience in Research & Development related to Biomedical Sciences, relevant to the job requirements in Govt./Public sector/Private Institutions will be admissible.

content_sections.text: In addition to the existing Government of India instructions on age relaxation, the prescribed age limit may be relaxed in the case of exceptionally meritorious candidates, based on their CVs/experience, with the approval of the DG, ICMR.

content_sections.heading: ICMR NIE Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection would be made based on a computer-based test (MCQs) or interview or both. The computer-based test would be based on the understanding of research methods, will be of qualifying nature, and the minimum qualifying requirement will be 75 percentile.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICMR NIE Recruitment
content_sections.text: Visit the official online portal at https://recruitment.icmr.org.in to register yourself. After registration, log in using the User ID and password received on your email and mobile number. Click on the 'Go to Application Form' button and fill in the mandatory details section by section. Upload self-attested or attested scanned copies of certificates and documents in support of educational qualifications, date of birth, category certificate, and experience. Upload a clear photograph (unattended, without cap or goggles) and signature as per instructions. Proceed to complete the fee payment through Net Banking, Credit Card, or Debit Card. Review all particulars carefully and submit the application form, then take a final printout of the application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Scanned copies of educational qualification certificates from Matric onwards Certificates of detailed marks obtained in courses Date of birth proof Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD) where applicable Experience certificates Scanned photograph and signature MCI/NMC registration certificate (for medical posts) No Objection Certificate (at the time of personal discussion for applicants working in Centre/State Government Departments, Public Sector Undertakings, or Govt. funded research agencies)

content_sections.heading: ICMR NIE Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted through online mode only on https://recruitment.icmr.org.in by 26th November 2026 till 5:30 PM. Candidates applying for a post must ensure that they fulfill eligibility conditions on the last date of submission of applications. Duplicate applications from any applicant will result in cancellation of all such applications. Relevant documents of educational qualification, specialization, and experience as claimed must be invariably uploaded. Applicants working in Government or public sector must submit a "No Objection Certificate" stating that the applicant will be relieved within one month of appointment order receipt. The qualifications and experience may be relaxed in the case of exceptionally meritorious candidates with the approval of DG, ICMR. All updates and communications will be displayed exclusively on the ICMR website.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ICMR NIE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 26th November 2026 till 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 scientific vacancies available across Scientist-D, Scientist-C, and Scientist-B posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for ICMR NIE Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1500/- for non-exempted candidates. SC, ST, Women, PWD, and EWS candidates are exempted from the application fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Scientist-D (Medical)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS or equivalent degree recognized by MCI/NMC along with 8 years of essential experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Scientist-B posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for Scientist-B posts is not exceeding 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a computer-based test in the selection process?
faq.answer: Yes, selection may involve a computer-based test (MCQs) of qualifying nature (minimum qualifying 75 percentile) based on research methods, or interview, or both.

faq.question: Q7. Where should candidates submit their online applications?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official portal at https://recruitment.icmr.org.in.

faq.question: Q8. Are female candidates required to pay the application fee?
faq.answer: No, female candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.
